rule: Condition (b) of a fast kernel: |y_fast - y_oracle| / max(sum|w*x|, 2^-126) <= tol. tol is the power of two just above the maximum measured over the whole corpus of tests/test_qwen38_fast_kernels.py. Condition (a), the FP64 bound gamma(2K+8)*sum|w*x| + 2*ulp32(r), applies to every kernel regardless.

fields.tol: power of two used by condition (b)
fields.max: largest measured (b) ratio over the corpus
fields.commit: commit whose harness run measured max and p99
fields.note: why this kernel's error has this size
